env_context_strategy.note: Not a repository/environment-context setting; tools are simulated by an LLM. Instance template not in the bundle.

context_compaction.note: The history processing code was truncated from the bundle.

observation_format.note: Simulated observations are text (JSON strings produced by the LLM simulator).

tool_call_format.note: LangChain ReAct-style 'Action / Action Input' text with a JSON input parsed by load_dict/get_first_json_object_str (safeagi/utils/tool.py).

tool_count.note: The tool count varies per dataset case (toolkits come from the data files); no fixed default.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: domain: medicine, cook, finance, everyday, chemistry
edit_primitive.note: The domains are simulated physical/finance tasks; there is no file-editing tool. The tool registry was not fully shown.

tool_schema_source.note: Tool specs are declarative parameter dicts (ToolEmu-style).

protocol_standardization.note: No dependency file or full-source grep is available in the bundle.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote:

loop_primitives.note: Default is the LangChain AgentExecutor ReAct loop; inspector critique/revise loop is enabled with the --regulation_check flag.

multi_agent_topology.note: Planner, safety inspector, simulator and evaluator are specialized LLM roles. Closest value is pipeline; the planner is single-acting.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: **safety inspector**: having access to safety regulations, based on which regulate the agent's behavior

long_term_memory.note: Hindsight memory of past actions and criticisms is used for fine-tuning; runtime re-injection is unclear.

self_verification.evidence_quote:

ing GPT-4 as the backbone LLM.

retry_policy.note: The --num-retries option retries failed executions (not verifier-driven).

termination_condition.evidence_quote: conclude by stating Final Answer directly.
termination_condition.note: The paper states that repeated mistakes after inspection halt the process. The LangChain max_iterations setting is likely but not shown.

timeouts.evidence_quote: help="Timeout for a single function execution request",
timeouts.note: The timeout applies per threaded function execution (per case), not per tool call. Closest value selected.
